about_short_description.short_description: Pickalbatros Hotels & Resorts develops and manages a wide variety of hotel properties and tourist attractions.

product.name: Hotel and Resort Accommodation
product.description: Provision of lodging services across multiple properties in Egypt and Morocco, catering to various guest preferences including family-friendly, adults-only, and sports-oriented stays.

product.name: Aqua Parks and Water-based Entertainment
product.description: Operation of aqua parks featuring water slides, pools, and water sports activities designed for both children and adults within resort properties.

product.name: Dining and Beverage Services
product.description: Provision of diverse dining options including multiple restaurants and bars offering international and local cuisines and beverages within resort and hotel properties.

product.name: Spa and Wellness Services
product.description: Provision of spa treatments, wellness therapies, and fitness facilities aimed at relaxation and health improvement for hotel guests.

product.name: Recreational and Sports Facilities
product.description: Offering sports and recreational amenities such as tennis courts, paddle courts, fitness classes, and water sports to enhance guest activities during their stay.
